description: Information about the rate limit for the current request.

limit.description: Limit of requests in the current window (usually 1 minute). Same as the 'X-RateLimit-Limit' header

remaining.description: Remaining requests in the current window. Same as the 'X-RateLimit-Remaining' header

used.description: Number of requests used in the current window.

reset.description: UNIX epoch timestamp (seconds) when the rate limit will reset. Same as the 'X-RateLimit-Reset' header
